voice.name: en-GB-SoniaNeural
voice.prosody: It looked like a totally ordinary morning. Lili, who was nine, sat curled up with her Nintendo, big headphones over her ears. Her twelve-year-old brother Leo was at his computer, building towers in Minecraft. Mum was in the kitchen flipping breakfast, and Dad was in the office, busy with work. Pip the hedgehog snoozed under the table, and Blaze the parrot dozed on his perch. But the morning was Not ordinary. Lili didn't know it yet, but someone had quietly switched her headphones to silent mode — which is why she couldn't hear a single thing Mum was saying.
